caveats: Project-synthetic benchmark: findings demonstrate architectural properties under controlled simulation, not production banking efficacy.
Scenario 7 is a post-training unseen typology (0 train instances; evaluated on validation and test partitions).
Oracle condition (CONSORTIUM_SIGNAL) is an upper-bound ablation utilizing generator-internal truth, not a production-realistic feature regime.
Monetary amounts represent synthetic testbed exposure in SYNTHETIC_USD, not actual realized customer savings or chargeback reductions.
Optimizer step and sample exposure counts differ between federated and centralized conditions under nominal 10-pass parity.
